description: Land Title Settlement Department - Medawelena, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830068
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, specifically the formal registration and determination of land titles by the Commissioner of Title Settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
